# Free AI Credits — Full Content

> Complete set of active free AI credit offers with summaries, claim context and source links — concatenated for LLM ingestion (Claude Code / Cursor). Generated at build time from src/data/offers.json and src/data/details.json.

Source: https://freetokens.custats.info/ — generated 2026-10-14T03:27:43Z — 138 of 216 active offers (truncated to stay under the 200KB llms-full budget; full directory at https://freetokens.custats.info/).

Trust fields: review_status, verification, signup, last_checked — the same schema values the short index defines at https://freetokens.custats.info/llms.txt. An offer's expiry date is its enrollment deadline — the last date to claim — not how long the credits stay valid. When a provider states how long claimed credits last, that term is in the amount text.

### MindsHub Free Tier — MindsHub Air and Jev Models
- Provider: MindsHub
- Category: api_provider
- Amount: MindsHub Air free for non-coding knowledge work within an organization-specific recurring weighted allowance (absolute size unpublished); Jev $0 launch promotion with 100,000 tokens and 100 requests refilled continuously over 24 hours for unfunded organizations while shared free capacity lasts; no card needed for these free allowances
- Status: active — enrollment deadline: none (ongoing)
- Last checked: 2026-10-13 — review_status=under-review · verification=social_proof · signup=required
- Source: https://mindshub.ai/pricing
- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/mindshub-free-tier.html
- Summary: MindsHub (by MindsDB, Inc.) advertises free access with no subscription or credit card for non-coding knowledge work with agents. MindsHub Air (API alias mindshub_air) uses a recurring, organization-specific weighted allowance whose absolute size is unpublished; an organization without a free grant has zero Air allowance. Air is an alias MindsHub can repoint to a different model. TypeSafe's Jev decision model (jev, through the Decisions API) costs $0 during a launch promotion, not guaranteed permanent free access. Unfunded organizations receive an allowance of 100,000 tokens and 100 requests while shared free capacity lasts; both refill continuously over 24 hours, capped at one day's allowance, rather than resetting at midnight. Jev does not consume Air's allowance. The broad fair-use policy says numeric daily limits are unpublished, but specific billing and Decisions docs publish Jev's limits; that statement must not be applied to Jev universally. Bulk pipelines, scripted volume traffic, scraping, reselling and multiple-account abuse are outside fair use and may lead to suspension. Air usage beyond its allowance is billed at published rates. No Jev promotion end date or completed API request was verified in the 2026-10-14 copy check.
- Claim steps: Create a free MindsHub account and obtain your API key from https://console.mindshub.ai; no card is required for the advertised free allowances. | Use MindsHub Air for non-coding knowledge work in MindsHub Agents or through Unified Inference with the alias mindshub_air. Its absolute weighted allowance is unpublished; organizations without a free grant have zero allowance. | Check Air's remaining allowance with GET https://auth.mindshub.ai/v1/entitlements/me/ using your API key. Read included_percent_remaining and next_refresh_at for your organization's grant. | Call Jev with model jev at POST https://api.mindshub.ai/v1/decisions using your MindsHub key; no separate TypeSafe key is needed. Unfunded organizations have both 100,000 tokens and 100 requests, refilled continuously over 24 hours while shared free capacity lasts. | Past the Jev allowance, or if shared free capacity runs out first, requests return 402 wallet_empty before the model runs. Wait for refill and available capacity, or fund the organization if you choose paid setup. | Wallet credit, or a card with a completed top-up and no unresolved payment error, lifts the daily Jev cap during the $0 promotion. Adding a card alone does not. Organization access and rate limits still apply. | Respect fair use: do not use the free tier for bulk pipelines, scripted volume traffic, scraping, reselling or multiple-account abuse. Check current pricing and account entitlements before use.

- Page: https://freetokens.custats.info/offers/hetzner-experiments-inference-api.html
- Summary: Hetzner's experimental Inference API exposes open-weight LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible REST API (base URL https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1 exposing /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions) and is free of charge while in experimental status — performance and availability are not guaranteed and it is not intended for production. Current models: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (MoE, 35B total / 3B active, vision) and Qwen3.8-27B (dense), both with 262,144-token context and text+image input. Rate limits per API key: 4M input and 100k output tokens per 60 seconds, plus 10 requests per 60 seconds; the /v1/models response is the definitive live model list.

Third-party models are not covered. | Do not confuse this with the separate $300 Google Cloud Free Trial.
